howto.name: Upload the PDF
howto.text: Drop a PDF up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Strip annotations
howto.text: Click Delete. PrivaTools removes every annotation object (highlights, comments, sticky notes, form fields, links).

howto.name: Download the cleaned PDF
howto.text: The visible page content is unchanged; all interactive annotations are gone.

faq.q: Will this remove form fields too?
faq.a: Yes — form fields are a type of annotation. To preserve form structure but clear values, use the Fill Form tool with empty values instead.
Yes — hyperlinks are link annotations. Use this to make a PDF completely 'read-only' as a static document.
Yes, signature annotations are removed too — which invalidates the cryptographic signature.
